description: OFF-BALL RUN VARIETY 4 - MORE THAN ONE MAN BREAKS AT A TIME (ChanceSpaceRun). THIS IS THE LEVER FOR 'RUNS ARE ONE-DIMENSIONAL'. HOW THE CAP WORKS, read out of the code. The dispatcher match::ai::ActionSelectorScore::vf2 (0x143df1080) stops handing out a run type when EITHER of two caps is hit: 0x143df1651 'cmp [ctx+0x24], ecx; jle' (the per-attack-level QUOTA) or 0x143df165b 'movzx eax,[sel+0xe4]; cmp ecx,eax; jge' (maxSlots, the ctor byte). For ChanceSpaceRun (action id 0x1e) maxSlots is 0x0b = 11 (ctor 0x143d51a3c 'mov dl,0xb'), so maxSlots is NOT the cap - the quota is, alone. The quota comes from 0x1442f9a90, whose case for 0x1e builds a 5-byte table on the stack from the immediates patched here and indexes it with the team's ATTACK LEVEL, [teamCtx+0xb450], clamped to 4. STOCK TABLE = {1,2,2,3,3}. So in settled possession at a low attack level the game authorises exactly ONE man to run into space, and the winner is fully determined (see below), which is why the same striker makes the same run every time. AFTER THIS PATCH = {2,3,3,4,4}. WHY THE WINNER IS ALWAYS THE SAME MAN - EMULATED. I ran ActionSelectorChanceSpaceRun::vf5 (0x143df5950, the scorer) under Unicorn against BOTH images with every call stubbed, sweeping the inputs. The entire score is: score = 100.0 + (signed char)[teamAI+0x28c] * player.x + roleBonus, i.e. 100 + attackDirection * the player's position up the pitch, plus a flat bonus for players passing 0x143d37f30 / 0x143d32a90. 28 rows matched that closed form to 1e-3 on the PRISTINE image (roleBonus = 100.0) and on the installed image (roleBonus = 20.0 after offball-chance-bonus.json). There is NO space term, NO distance-to-ball term and NO pass-likelihood term in the ranking. The dispatcher sorts those scores descending (sort 0x143b45ce0, comparator 0x143df1060 comparing record+4 = the score) and takes the top N, stopping at the first score <= 0 (0x143df1384). So the ranking is 'whoever is furthest up the pitch, unless someone carries the role flag'. Raising N is the only way to get a second and third man moving, because the ordering itself cannot be varied without new code. NO RNG ANYWHERE: I built a global direct-call graph of the whole image (943,597 E8 edges), took every function containing the LCG multiplier 0x2d22b2e3 (0x144345d90 / e00 / e50 / eb0 / 0x1443461a0) plus every direct caller of them as the RNG set, and searched 6 levels deep. The manager update (60 fns), the dispatcher (75), and all four selectors' vf4/vf5/vf6 (29 to 795 fns each) reach NO RNG. Two controls in the same run DID hit it (the kick randomiser 0x14401a060 at depth 0, and 0x14567b670 in the ball-player code), so the method works. Caveat: virtual and other indirect calls are not followed. WHAT TO WATCH FOR: two or three runners may pick similar lines, because vf6 computes each run's target without knowing about the other runners - if the front players bunch, step the table back toward stock. Offside risk rises with runner count. Also note quota 4 at the top attack level is still under maxSlots 11, so nothing overflows. WHO: everyone. 0x143d03493 is the ONLY reference to the manager update 0x143d52470 in the image (I byte-scanned every E8/E9 rel32 myself), and its guard is 'mov ecx,[match+0x3318]; and ecx,1; cmp ecx,[teamAI+8]; jne skip'. [match+0x3318] is the match FRAME COUNTER (many sites do 'frame - storedStamp' and compare the difference against an fps-derived frame count, e.g. 0x143c59c82 'sub eax,[rbx+0x10]; cmp eax,3'), so the two teams simply ALTERNATE FRAMES - this is not a possession test. There is no human/CPU test on the path, so the human's AI team-mates get this exactly as much as the CPU. EVIDENCE: (a) emulated for the score formula and the RNG search; (b) disassembly for the two caps, the sort, the quota table and the frame-parity guard; (c) inferred that the attack level 0..4 corresponds to what a viewer would call build-up vs all-out attack. BYTES: both instructions are byte-identical in the PRISTINE backup and the installed exe, both edits are inline immediates of the same length, and NO pool cell is touched. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/offball-quota-chance.json
